newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 10.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 10.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to large shipping on Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Puerto Penasco in Sonora was closed to smaller tourism and fishing.
The ministry said Hurricane Dolores' winds had relaxed to between 65 and 80 knots (124 km/72 miles and 152 km/88 miles) and continued to head west, away from Mexico's Pacific coast.
Ships were still advised not to sail near the hurricane, about 1,240 miles (1,984 km) west-southwest of the coast of southern Baja California.
Tropical storms blew strong winds through southern Mexico from Mexico City to Guerrero state. Electric storms and strong winds in Oaxaca and Chiapas.
